units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sotah 1:2">Sot. I, 2</cite> (<cite ref="Sotah 2a:3">2ᵃ</cite>) <he>נכנסה עמו לבית הס׳</he> (not <he>בס׳</he>) if she went with him to a closeted place, v. <cite ref="O01701"><he>סְתִירָה</he></cite>.
Gen. R. s. 45 סִיתְרָהּ, v. גָּלוּי.—בַּסֵּ׳ in secret.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 9b:11">B. Bath. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>גדול העושה צדקה בס׳ וכ׳</he> he that dispenses charity in secret, is greater than Moses.

<cite ref="Chagigah 16a:11">Ḥag. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>העובר עבירה בס׳ וכ׳</he> he who selects a secret place for committing a sin, is considered as though he pushed away the feet of the Divine Presence (denying the omniscience of God).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:4">Ab. IV, 4</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>סְתָרִים</he>, constr. <he>סִתְרֵי</he>, <cite ref="O00067"><he>סִי׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 9:3">Mikv. IX, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 15:9">Lev. R. s. 15</cite>, a. fr. <he>בית הס׳</he> covered parts of the body, posteriors &c.

<cite ref="Megillah 3a:18">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>מי הוא זה שגילה סְתָרַיי וכ׳</he> who is he that revealed my secrets to men? <cite ref="Megillah 3a:18">Ib.</cite> <he>אני … סְתָרֶיךָ</he> I did reveal thy secrets.
<cite ref="Chagigah 11b:16">Ḥag. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>סתרי עריות</he> the secrets of the laws of incest, i.e. the laws not explicitly stated (cmp. <cite ref="O01707"><he>סְתָם</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:4:3">Y. Keth. V, 29ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>סיתרי תורה</he> the secrets of the Law, i.e. logical deductions; a. fr.
